title: LKValues: Aligning Large Language Models with Sri Lankan Societal Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on a bilingual value-sensitive judgment benchmark (LKvaluesBench) to assess alignment with Sri Lankan societal values versus defaulting to generic or Western norms, using both local and universal prompt framings.

Comparing model accuracy, invalid-output rates, and format adherence on identical value judgment tasks between English and Sinhala to measure cross-lingual performance disparities in a low-resource setting.
